title: PERSISTENT
tagline: A finished draft — twenty-nine chapters — waiting for its line-by-line pass.
statusNote: Written through to the end, and not yet read back. It has had no line-by-line review, so it is not finished work and it is not being shown to anyone.
description: PERSISTENT is a complete draft: twenty-nine chapters, written start to end.

What it has not had is the slow pass — the one where every line gets read again and most of them get changed. Until Mike has done that, there is no description of this book on this page, because the version worth describing is not the version that exists yet.
It is not in advance reading, no part of it is published, and there is nothing here to sign up for. It is listed because it is real and it is finished as a draft — that is the whole claim.

cover.alt: Front cover of PERSISTENT by Mike Ramsey, subtitled 'A human-AI collaborative novel': the title in cream capitals over a near-black ground, across which dozens of fine pale-green lines sweep diagonally like currents, threading through scattered fragments of torn paper and knotting at a small orange ring near the centre.
